proposals.title: Warm brick bay bands on facade tower
proposals.change: Add two narrow warm-brick vertical bay bands to facade_tower_proxy with bright unlit height-field breakup.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a small additive proxy offset from the tower face; keep intensity restrained and preserve the existing HF-lit silhouette.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Small bright facade accents preserve the frozen FOV density and avoid dark sole-material coverage.
proposals.acceptance_test: Loop52 capture remains 11/11 usable; City and Wide show two readable brick bands without clipping or black patches.

proposals.title: Bright plaster window-strip accents
proposals.change: Add one thin pale-plaster window strip to apartment_midrise_proxy with alternating bright recess marks.
proposals.implementation_notes: Limit the strip to a small mid-height facade region and use soft rectangular accents rather than full emissive windows.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The change is a narrow additive facade proxy and does not replace any existing HF material.
proposals.acceptance_test: City and PropHub retain usable framing with visible pale plaster rhythm and no harsh bloom.

proposals.title: Corrugated roof cap behind wall
proposals.change: Place a small bright corrugated roof cap on facade_tower_proxy behind the gameplay wall.
proposals.implementation_notes: Keep the cap at x>=bx+3 and scale it as a shallow skyline accent with light gray-blue corrugation.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Hero-authored geometry remains behind the wall and cannot occupy the frozen foreground FOV.
proposals.acceptance_test: City gains a readable roofline accent while Prop, City, and Wide remain 11/11 usable.

proposals.title: Craneboom diagonal light plane
proposals.change: Add a narrow warm highlight plane along the upper diagonal of harbor_crane_proxy.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a thin proxy strip following the boom; keep emissive strength below bloom threshold and retain visible dark-to-light separation.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Small additive geometry improves crane recognition without introducing a large hero stack.
proposals.acceptance_test: Harbor and Wide show a clean diagonal crane edge with no sun-washout and no camera usability loss.

proposals.title: Crane gantry joint markers
proposals.change: Add three small amber joint markers to harbor_crane_proxy at the gantry pivots.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use tiny emissive discs or cubes only at existing joints; avoid continuous lighting across the crane frame.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Three isolated points are low-area additions and remain compatible with the frozen HF treatment.
proposals.acceptance_test: Harbor reads the crane articulation at capture distance without visible bloom spikes or new black mass.

proposals.title: Muted bright container color blocks
proposals.change: Add two small alternating blue and rust-orange container blocks to container_ship_proxy.
proposals.implementation_notes: Place the blocks at x>=bx+3 and keep their value above the ocean background; use restrained saturation and no full-deck stack.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The authored ship detail is behind the wall and uses bright materials instead of dark PBR.
proposals.acceptance_test: Harbor gains two distinct cargo color notes with no foreground occlusion and no drop below Usable.

proposals.title: Freighter bow warm rim
proposals.change: Add a thin warm-white additive rim along the upper bow contour of freighter_proxy.
proposals.implementation_notes: Restrict the rim to the upper bow arc and keep it narrow enough to read as a contour, not a glowing hull.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: A single small emissive contour improves silhouette separation while avoiding a large authored hero surface.
proposals.acceptance_test: Harbor and Ocean retain usable silhouettes with a visible bow contour and no clipped highlight.

proposals.title: Pier edge rhythm blocks
proposals.change: Add four small bright edge blocks along one pier_section_proxy side.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use tiny unlit HF blocks aligned to the existing pier edge; keep them at x~=bx+1/+2 and below the dominant facade contrast.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The accents are small, bright unlit HF geometry within the frozen FOV density budget.
proposals.acceptance_test: Both Harbor and Ocean show four readable pier breaks while all 11 cameras remain usable.

proposals.title: Seawall cap highlight
proposals.change: Add one narrow pale cap strip to seawall_proxy following the top edge.
proposals.implementation_notes: Keep the cap strip discontinuous with two small gaps so it reads as worn concrete rather than a continuous light bar.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The narrow additive line lifts seawall readability without increasing dark foreground coverage.
proposals.acceptance_test: Harbor and Ocean show a broken seawall cap edge with no washout and unchanged usability.

proposals.title: Seawall relief-panel accents
proposals.change: Place two pale rectangular relief panels on seawall_proxy behind the wall.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use shallow geometry at x>=bx+3 with low-contrast cream-gray material and no full-face replacement.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The authored relief remains behind the wall and cannot compromise Prop, City, Ocean, or Wide.
proposals.acceptance_test: Harbor gains two visible panel breaks from the approved camera without foreground occlusion.

proposals.title: Nearshore foam ribbon
proposals.change: Add one thin additive foam ribbon parallel to the coast_block_proxy shoreline.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a short broken ribbon with low emissive intensity and soft opacity; keep coverage under a small fraction of the ocean surface.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Sparse additive foam adds shoreline separation without painting the ocean pure white or black.
proposals.acceptance_test: Ocean and Wide show a readable shoreline break with no extreme washout and no loss of usability.

proposals.title: Three breaker foam patches
proposals.change: Add three small irregular foam patches on the front edge of coast_block_proxy.
proposals.implementation_notes: Keep each patch separate, horizontally compressed, and warm off-white; avoid continuous ocean coverage and pure-white finals.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Tiny sparse patches improve wave vocabulary while maintaining ocean color variation and the frozen density profile.
proposals.acceptance_test: Ocean reads three distinct breaker accents with preserved blue-green water and no bloom spikes.

proposals.title: Wet-sand value plane
proposals.change: Add a small bright wet-sand plane beneath the visible shoreline on coast_block_proxy.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use tan-gray unlit HF material with a restrained roughness breakup; keep the plane narrow and avoid a mirror-like sheen.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: A narrow bright HF plane adds shoreline contrast without introducing dark PBR or reflective washout.
proposals.acceptance_test: Ocean and Wide show a warm wet-sand band that remains visibly distinct from the water and sky.

proposals.title: Wet-sand micro-rill accents
proposals.change: Add two short pale rill marks across the wet-sand strip on coast_block_proxy.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use two broken, low-intensity lines angled toward the water; keep their length below the primary shoreline span.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Only two small additive marks are introduced, so the ocean remains color-rich and uncluttered.
proposals.acceptance_test: Ocean shows two subtle sand-flow cues without white clipping, black pooling, or camera usability loss.

proposals.title: Submarine sail highlight
proposals.change: Add a small pale additive highlight to the upper sail of submarine_proxy.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a single narrow highlight on the sail crest; keep the submarine body out of full emissive treatment and preserve surrounding water color.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The small sail accent improves object recognition without creating a dark or oversized ocean hero.
proposals.acceptance_test: Ocean and Wide retain usable water composition with a readable pale sail edge and no black silhouette collapse.

proposals.title: Coast-block bright plaster face
proposals.change: Add one small bright plaster face patch to coast_block_proxy at the visible land-water transition.
proposals.implementation_notes: Place the patch at x>=bx+3 with warm gray plaster and a few pale salt streaks; avoid covering the existing shoreline read.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The authored face is behind the wall and uses bright plaster rather than dark PBR.
proposals.acceptance_test: City and Ocean retain clear land-water separation and the new plaster patch is visible only as a small secondary accent.

proposals.title: Apartment corrugated service strip
proposals.change: Add one narrow bright corrugated service strip to apartment_midrise_proxy.
proposals.implementation_notes: Use a short vertical strip at x~=bx+1/+2 with pale galvanized value and low-frequency ribbing for readable edge separation.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The strip is small, bright, and unlit HF-compatible with the frozen city pass.
proposals.acceptance_test: City shows a single readable corrugated detail with no material washout and unchanged camera usability.

proposals.title: Crane counterweight safety stripe
proposals.change: Add one short yellow safety stripe to the counterweight of harbor_crane_proxy.
proposals.implementation_notes: Restrict the stripe to the existing counterweight face and use a soft additive value that remains below highlight clipping.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: One short additive stripe is a low-area recognition cue and does not alter the crane silhouette mass.
proposals.acceptance_test: Harbor shows the stripe as a distinct safety color without bloom, sun washout, or loss of usable framing.

proposals.title: Ship deckhouse bright trim
proposals.change: Add a small pale trim strip around the upper deckhouse of container_ship_proxy.
proposals.implementation_notes: Place the trim at x>=bx+3 and limit it to the upper deckhouse outline; avoid adding a full bright hull or container stack.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: The small authored trim is behind the wall and cannot compromise the frozen foreground composition.
proposals.acceptance_test: Harbor and Wide gain deckhouse separation with no new dark mass and no camera dropping below Usable.

proposals.title: Foam fleck cluster at seawall outlet
proposals.change: Add a sparse cluster of five small off-white foam flecks where seawall_proxy meets the water.
proposals.implementation_notes: Keep flecks low, separated, and slightly warm; cap opacity and emissive intensity so the cluster reads as foam rather than a white bar.
proposals.capture_safe_reason: Sparse additive flecks are tiny, localized, and preserve both ocean color variation and the approved HF density.
proposals.acceptance_test: Harbor and Ocean show a localized foam contact cue with no pure-black ocean, white clipping, or usability regression.
